verdict.rationale: The only AI reference is a generic mention of "AI workflows that move visas and green cards forward faster," which does not describe AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data. The personalized assessments, eligibility checks and evidence mapping are attributed to attorneys or presented as structured workflows, not as AI-generated output, so they are adjacent features rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
